script.title: Captain Science: The Atomic Hero's Explosive Sacrifice
script.description: Captain Science battles the Beast-Men of Rak in a high-stakes mission to save Earth from total conquest.

shots.narration: Captain Science triggers a massive explosion, vaporizing the enemy fortress!
He carries the girl to safety as the base crumbles.
But how did this atomic hero start his war on evil?
It began when Gordon Dane spotted an unearthly flying saucer.
A mysterious alien approaches, citing his work with Dr. Einstein.
The alien gifts him a mechanical brain to fight the Beast-Men.
Using his father's vast wealth, he builds a high-tech laboratory.
The alien ship self-destructs with ultrasonic power, leaving no trace.
The Beast-Men of Rak plot to conquer Earth using evil thought waves.
Captain Science infiltrates their fortress, using the password Galactic.
He is quickly discovered by hooded guards in the dark tunnels.
They strap him to the Hypno-Wheel to force a confession.
The light intensifies, but he refuses to break under the pressure.
A mysterious woman named Luana visits his cell, seeking his help.
She reveals her own father is one of the enemy leaders.
They race to the power room, using an M-Box to melt the door.
Guards swarm them as he reaches for the final switch.
WHOOOM! The explosion tears through the base, ending the threat.
Luana's father is lost, but the fight against evil continues.
